description: Siemens SIPROTEC 5 7SL87 distance zones (function '21 Distance prot.1', zones Z1..Zn) as a DIGSI 5 setting sheet prints them, with the DIGSI address written inside each setting name (21.901.357n.xxx). Catalog-only, verified subset: per-zone Mode (status), Directional mode, Function mode (loops), X reach, R (ph-ph), R (ph-g), Zone-inclination angle (tilt), zone-specific Kr / Kx, the CT / VT ratings, the Edit-mode basis and the line data. The operating-delay setting cells on the sheet are blank (Infinity is printed in the range column): every delay is Missing. The characteristic is not named by the sheet and is not assumed; the polygon's inclined resistance boundaries (Dist. characteristic angle) cannot be represented and are preserved as a capability gap.
interpretation_notes: Zone N is the zone 'Z N' of function '21 Distance prot.1' (DIGSI addresses 21.901.357N.xxx); the numbering follows the sheet.
The sheet's Edit mode is Primary: the impedance values on the sheet are primary ohms.

Every operating delay (1-phase and multi-phase) has a blank setting cell; the 'Infinity' beside it is the range column, not a configured delay. No delay is assumed, and the document notes' timers are not used.

The sheet does not name the zone characteristic, so none is assumed. The zone geometry is stated as X reach, R (ph-ph) and R (ph-g) limits; the resistance boundaries are inclined at the distance characteristic angle (21.901.2311.107), which the current model cannot draw; that setting is preserved with every zone. No left (-R) boundary is stated.

zone_preserved.reason: The polygon's resistance boundaries are inclined at the distance characteristic angle. The current model draws resistance limits as vertical lines, so this geometry cannot be represented; the setting is preserved, not approximated.
A zone operating / blocking switch of the vendor's scheme logic; it does not change the zone's geometry and is not interpreted.
K0 / Angle (K0) are the other residual-compensation format; this sheet is set to the Kr, Kx format (91.115). Preserved, not used.

mappings.note: Rated primary current of the 3-phase CT measuring point (no unit printed; amperes).
Rated secondary current of the 3-phase CT measuring point (printed '1 A').
Rated primary voltage of the 3-phase VT measuring point, printed without a unit; kV is assumed (the sheet's 275kV header and the line's rated voltage agree) and converted to volts. Confirm the unit.
Rated secondary voltage of the 3-phase VT measuring point, printed without a unit; volts are assumed. Confirm the unit.
DIGSI 5 Edit mode: the basis in which the sheet's settings are stated.
Line length as printed; the sheet prints no length unit.
The zone's own Mode setting (on / off). 'test' is not interpreted.
Function mode states which loops the zone measures.
Function mode states which loops the zone measures.

The zone is stated as X and R limits (X reach, R (ph-ph), R (ph-g)), not as a polar reach. Its resistance boundaries are inclined at the distance characteristic angle, which this representation cannot carry (preserved with the zone).
R (ph-ph), the phase-phase resistance reach, as printed.
R (ph-g), the phase-ground resistance reach, as printed. Not drawn by the phase-phase engine.
The inclination of the zone's X reach line, as stated.
Operate delay for multi-phase faults, read as the phase-phase loop delay (multi-phase faults include phase-phase-earth faults; the loop assignment is an assumption).
Operate delay for single-phase faults, read as the earth-loop delay (the loop assignment is an assumption).
